name: The Rested
flavor: Though waves may break, my ship shall take me off to the Land of Nod.
power: Reveal · Lucid Rest: this Reveal, each Landscape you place draws you 1 Psyche (up to 3).

name: The Visionary
flavor: Peer deep enough within yourself and you will find the seed of everything.
power: Reveal · Second Sight: place 2 Landscapes from the Vault, free.

name: The Runner
flavor: Nothing's faster than thought, and I *am* thought.

name: The Hunter
flavor: No Prey can escape my chase.
power: Explore · Lure: every Dreambeast moves up to 2 Landscapes toward you, or away from you.

name: The Immovable
flavor: Even Time stands still for those who wait long enough.
power: Meet · Hold the Line: every fight this Meet rolls 2 more dice.

name: The Weaver
flavor: Strands of fate, woven as I will it.
power: Meet · Reweave: discard up to 3 Psyche, then draw that many plus 1.
